name: Buddy Ryan's 46 Defense
description: The most aggressive defense in NFL history. Ends aligned head-up at tight-end width, tackles shaded inside, three linebackers bunched at 2-3 yards, and BOTH safeties walked into an eight-man box with zero deep-middle help. Corners survive on islands in press-man. The base picture alone forces offenses to abandon their blocking rules; the mad-dog mug, E-X-T combo, and free blade blitzes turn that confusion into sacks.
